controls.description: A mutation that allows Manual -> Auto switch without confirmation must be killed by refusal check.
A mutation that allows identical MIDI pitch duplicate in manual voicing must be killed.
A mutation that renders raw HTML tags in annotations must be killed by markup sanitization.
A mutation that overwrites custom/unrecognized chords with a guessed canonical chord must be killed.
A mutation that permits annotations longer than 500 code points must be killed by length refusal.
A mutation that renders piano keys outside the 88-key physical MIDI bounds (21..108) must be killed.
A mutation that drops 3rd/7th guide tone identification on piano keys must be killed.
A mutation that alters chord quality without synchronizing spelled degrees and pitch classes must be killed.
